entries.title: Joshua 15:1
segments: ¶So [this] was the lot of the tribe of the children of Judah according to their families: The border of Edom at the Wilderness of Zin southward [was] the extreme southern boundary.

entries.title: Joshua 15:2
segments: And their southern border began at the shore of the Salt Sea, from the bay that faces southward.

entries.title: Joshua 15:3
segments: Then it went out to the southern side of the Ascent of Akrabbim, passed along to Zin, ascended on the south side of Kadesh Barnea, passed along to Hezron, went up to Adar, and went around to Karkaa.

entries.title: Joshua 15:4
segments: [From there] it passed toward Azmon and went out to the Brook of Egypt; and the border ended at the sea. This shall be your southern border.

entries.title: Joshua 15:5
segments: The east border [was] the Salt Sea as far as the mouth of the Jordan. And the border on the northern quarter [began] at the bay of the sea at the mouth of the Jordan.

entries.title: Joshua 15:6
segments: The border went up to Beth Hoglah and passed north of Beth Arabah; and the border went up to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben.

entries.title: Joshua 15:7
segments: Then the border went up toward Debir from the Valley of Achor, and it turned northward toward Gilgal, which [is] before the Ascent of Adummim, which [is] on the south side of the valley. The border continued toward the waters of En Shemesh and ended at En Rogel.

entries.title: Joshua 15:8
segments: And the border went up by the Valley of the Son of Hinnom to the southern slope of the Jebusite [city] (which [is] Jerusalem). The border went up to the top of the mountain that [lies] before the Valley of Hinnom westward, which [is] at the end of the Valley of Rephaim northward.

entries.title: Joshua 15:9
segments: Then the border went around from the top of the hill to the fountain of the water of Nephtoah, and extended to the cities of Mount Ephron. And the border went around to Baalah (which [is] Kirjath Jearim).

entries.title: Joshua 15:10
segments: Then the border turned westward from Baalah to Mount Seir, passed along to the side of Mount Jearim on the north (which [is] Chesalon), went down to Beth Shemesh, and passed on to Timnah.

entries.title: Joshua 15:11
segments: And the border went out to the side of Ekron northward. Then the border went around to Shicron, passed along to Mount Baalah, and extended to Jabneel; and the border ended at the sea.

entries.title: Joshua 15:12
segments: The west border [was] the coastline of the Great Sea. This [is] the boundary of the children of Judah all around according to their families.

entries.title: Joshua 15:13
segments: ¶Now to Caleb the son of Jephunneh he gave a share among the children of Judah, according to the commandment of the LORD to Joshua, [namely], Kirjath Arba, which [is] Hebron ([Arba was] the father of Anak).

entries.title: Joshua 15:14
segments: Caleb drove out the three sons of Anak from there: Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai, the children of Anak.

entries.title: Joshua 15:15
segments: Then he went up from there to the inhabitants of Debir (formerly the name of Debir [was] Kirjath Sepher).

entries.title: Joshua 15:16
segments: And Caleb said, "He who attacks Kirjath Sepher and takes it, to him I will give Achsah my daughter as wife."

entries.title: Joshua 15:17
segments: So Othniel the son of Kenaz, the brother of Caleb, took it; and he gave him Achsah his daughter as wife.

entries.title: Joshua 15:18
segments: Now it was so, when she came [to him], that she persuaded him to ask her father for a field. So she dismounted from [her] donkey, and Caleb said to her, "What do you wish?"

entries.title: Joshua 15:19
segments: She answered, "Give me a blessing; since you have given me land in the South, give me also springs of water." So he gave her the upper springs and the lower springs.

entries.title: Joshua 15:20
segments: ¶This [was] the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Judah according to their families:

entries.title: Joshua 15:21
segments: The cities at the limits of the tribe of the children of Judah, toward the border of Edom in the South, were Kabzeel, Eder, Jagur,

entries.title: Joshua 15:22
segments: Kinah, Dimonah, Adadah,

entries.title: Joshua 15:23
segments: Kedesh, Hazor, Ithnan,

entries.title: Joshua 15:24
segments: Ziph, Telem, Bealoth,

entries.title: Joshua 15:25
segments: Hazor, Hadattah, Kerioth, Hezron (which [is] Hazor),

entries.title: Joshua 15:26
segments: Amam, Shema, Moladah,

entries.title: Joshua 15:27
segments: Hazar Gaddah, Heshmon, Beth Pelet,

entries.title: Joshua 15:28
segments: Hazar Shual, Beersheba, Bizjothjah,

entries.title: Joshua 15:29
segments: Baalah, Ijim, Ezem,

entries.title: Joshua 15:30
segments: Eltolad, Chesil, Hormah,

entries.title: Joshua 15:31
segments: Ziklag, Madmannah, Sansannah,

entries.title: Joshua 15:32
segments: Lebaoth, Shilhim, Ain, and Rimmon: all the cities [are] twenty-nine, with their villages.

entries.title: Joshua 15:33
segments: In the lowland: Eshtaol, Zorah, Ashnah,

entries.title: Joshua 15:34
segments: Zanoah, En Gannim, Tappuah, Enam,

entries.title: Joshua 15:35
segments: Jarmuth, Adullam, Socoh, Azekah,

entries.title: Joshua 15:36
segments: Sharaim, Adithaim, Gederah, and Gederothaim: fourteen cities with their villages;

entries.title: Joshua 15:37
segments: Zenan, Hadashah, Migdal Gad,

entries.title: Joshua 15:38
segments: Dilean, Mizpah, Joktheel,

entries.title: Joshua 15:39
segments: Lachish, Bozkath, Eglon,

entries.title: Joshua 15:40
segments: Cabbon, Lahmas, Kithlish,

entries.title: Joshua 15:41
segments: Gederoth, Beth Dagon, Naamah, and Makkedah: sixteen cities with their villages;

entries.title: Joshua 15:42
segments: Libnah, Ether, Ashan,

entries.title: Joshua 15:43
segments: Jiphtah, Ashnah, Nezib,

entries.title: Joshua 15:44
segments: Keilah, Achzib, and Mareshah: nine cities with their villages;

entries.title: Joshua 15:45
segments: Ekron, with its towns and villages;

entries.title: Joshua 15:46
segments: from Ekron to the sea, all that [lay] near Ashdod, with their villages;

entries.title: Joshua 15:47
segments: Ashdod with its towns and villages, Gaza with its towns and villages-as far as the Brook of Egypt and the Great Sea with [its] coastline.

entries.title: Joshua 15:48
segments: And in the mountain country: Shamir, Jattir, Sochoh,

entries.title: Joshua 15:49
segments: Dannah, Kirjath Sannah (which [is] Debir),

entries.title: Joshua 15:50
segments: Anab, Eshtemoh, Anim,

entries.title: Joshua 15:51
segments: Goshen, Holon, and Giloh: eleven cities with their villages;

entries.title: Joshua 15:52
segments: Arab, Dumah, Eshean,

entries.title: Joshua 15:53
segments: Janum, Beth Tappuah, Aphekah,

entries.title: Joshua 15:54
segments: Humtah, Kirjath Arba (which [is] Hebron), and Zior: nine cities with their villages;

entries.title: Joshua 15:55
segments: Maon, Carmel, Ziph, Juttah,

entries.title: Joshua 15:56
segments: Jezreel, Jokdeam, Zanoah,

entries.title: Joshua 15:57
segments: Kain, Gibeah, and Timnah: ten cities with their villages;

entries.title: Joshua 15:58
segments: Halhul, Beth Zur, Gedor,

entries.title: Joshua 15:59
segments: Maarath, Beth Anoth, and Eltekon: six cities with their villages;

entries.title: Joshua 15:60
segments: Kirjath Baal (which [is] Kirjath Jearim) and Rabbah: two cities with their villages.

entries.title: Joshua 15:61
segments: In the wilderness: Beth Arabah, Middin, Secacah,

entries.title: Joshua 15:62
segments: Nibshan, the City of Salt, and En Gedi: six cities with their villages.

entries.title: Joshua 15:63
segments: As for the Jebusites, the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the children of Judah could not drive them out; but the Jebusites dwell with the children of Judah at Jerusalem to this day.
